title: Smart FENDEE Shoe Cabinet with 2 Flip Slatted Drawers, Farmhouse Slim Shoe Organizer Rack with Golden Handles, Freestanding Hidden Entryway Storage for Hallway, Natural

reviews.title: Shoe Storage  Clutter Stopper
reviews.body: This is an attractive way to store the shoes. The description was accurate for the size of shoes it can hold. One of us wears a size 13 and they are tucked away nicely. It is high quality. The directions to assemble were very clear and it was easy to put together.  The color looks nice like a piece of furniture. The doors open very nicely and our room looks less cluttered.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 5, 2026
reviews.author: Pam

reviews.title: Perfect and Looks Great!
reviews.body: Living in a 75 year old house has its challenges with small closets.  The FENDEE shoe storage cabinet fits perfectly in my bedroom and looks very nice.  I can store 16 pairs of shoes: flats, sneakers, slippers, and heels. It was a bit of a challenge to put it together, but nothing that I couldn’t handle.  It seems to be well made for the price.  The slats in front provide ventilation and the back is fairly open.  Just know that you can see the soles of your shoes in the area between the slats.  I put the dark soled shoes on the bottom shelf of each drawer as they are less noticeable than the lighter colored soles.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 1, 2025

reviews.title: Hidden airy shoe storage
reviews.body: Waiting for my son to be able to come put it together. He has the same shoe cabinet and I loved his so ordered one for me. Price is fair and since I live alone it will last me a long time. My son’s is well made, holds adequate amount of shoes and the color is perfect. reviews.author: SJB

reviews.title: Held together by flimsy connections, fell apart immediately
reviews.body: 31 weeks pregnant here. This is not our first build-it-yourself piece of furniture that we purchased off of Amazon, and I found it easy to follow instructions and assemble from start to finish. I even got so far as putting all my husbands shoes because that’s why we got it. Right after we filled it up with shoes (3 pairs per level) the bottom drawer fell off.It’s held on by this flimsy connection of two plastic pieces, one embedded in the side panel, and one that connects the drawer to the side panel, and the shortest tiniest screw which is supposed to hold everything together. We figured it was possible I assembled it wrong, leaving a gap so large that the screw could not hold the drawer to the side panel - so we took the screws out of the plastic panel which makes up the side of the drawer and re screwed it in closer to the side panel that it is supposed to connect to. Didn’t work. Then we tried to use a larger screw from what was left over. Didn’t work. In the end we concluded the wood quality was poor and once the screw fell out, it could not retain any more screws going forward. We tested this out by removing the bottom drawer entirely and trying the screw in by itself without any weight on it and after screwing it in, we were able to remove it with our hands.Unfortunately we had to then take this whole piece of furniture apart to ship it back for a return which I was very disappointed about as it was no easy feat assembling furniture this pregnant, and this put a delay on our nesting to-do list. We so wanted to love it but sadly can’t recommend buying this product to anyone looking for cheap shoe storage.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 15, 2025
reviews.author: Andrew Atalla

reviews.title: Beautiful cabinet!
reviews.body: This is a really beautiful cabinet! Assembly was easy, but the total cabinet is very heavy (67lbs), so once assembled it was difficult to move. Once it was settled into its spot though, it’s just perfect and looks high end. I’m happy with this purchase.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
reviews.author: Darlene

reviews.title: Low quality parts
reviews.body: The hardware is very cheap as must be expected with this kind of product, but the attachment of drawers to the frame is basically non-functional.  The design consists of a very short screw that holds two round plastic pieces together to allow the rotation movement.  The screw doesn't stay in.  I will have to drill through and install a bolt to secure the drawer to the frame.  Generally speaking the whole mechanism of the drawers leaves a lot to be desired.  Other than that, the assembly instructions are good and I like the look of the unit.  After fixing it will be alright but I doubt this furniture will be durable.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 9, 2025

features: 【Modern and Farmhouse Design】This shoe cabinet features unique grille-striped doors that showcase its distinctive design. The natural oak finish not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of your entryway but also ensures good airflow inside the cabinet, seamlessly combining rustic charm with modern elegance. The gold handles and solid wood legs complement it beautifully, making it a perfect fit for any decor style

【Ample Storage Capacity】Designed for storing a variety of shoes, this entryway shoe cabinet boasts a spacious top surface ideal for placing keys, bags, and everyday items. The two drawers feature adjustable shelves to accommodate shoes of different heights, including flip-flops, dress shoes, high heels, casual shoes, and boots. The open lower shelf is perfect for keeping shoes and a robot vacuum cleaner

【Hidden Flip-Down Design】This narrow shoe cabinet comes with two hidden flip-down drawers, allowing for easy access to multiple pairs of shoes while keeping them organized and out of sight. It's perfect for the entryway, hallway, living room, or porch, effectively protecting your shoes from dust, water stains, sun exposure, and pet interference
【Thoughtful Safety Features】The freestanding shoe cabinet includes a anti-tip device on the back, allowing it to be securely attached to the wall, preventing tipping and ensuring child safety

【Easy Assembly】Rest assured, this shoe cabinet comes with comprehensive instructions that simplify the assembly process. Each part is clearly labeled, and precise guidelines make it easy for you to put it together without hassle
